title: ADA 2024 antihyperglycaemic drug classes
guide: Anchor the mechanisms of metformin, sulfonylureas, SGLT2 inhibitors, GLP-1 RAs and DPP-4 inhibitors. SGLT2i and GLP-1 RA carry CV outcome benefit; gliclazide is the preferred sulfonylurea; pioglitazone is contraindicated in HF.

title: ADA 2024 drug combinations and insulin indications
sec: ADA 2024 drug combinations and insulin indications · p934
guide: Dual therapy is recommended for HbA1c ≥1.5% above target. Insulin is mandatory for type 1, pregnancy hyperglycaemia, HbA1c ≥10% and ketosis; SGLT2i should be added for cardio-renal benefit even when glycaemia is controlled.

title: Multifactorial management: BP, lipids, antiplatelet, NASH
sec: Multifactorial management: BP, lipids, antiplatelet, NASH · p935
guide: Targets: BP <130/80 (<120/80 in CKD with proteinuria), LDL <130/100/70/55 by risk, aspirin 75 mg >40 yr with risk factors. Renal protection uses ACEi + SGLT2i + finerenone; semaglutide and saroglitazar improve NASH.
